user.title: SPAN Panel (eBus)
user.description:
Sign in with your SPAN account. Your password is used once to obtain access tokens and is never stored.

The device UUID is the per-install client identifier your SPAN mobile app registered; SPAN's cloud publishes live telemetry only on the channel bound to it. Setup verifies that telemetry actually arrives before finishing.

data_description.device_uuid: The client device UUID captured from your SPAN mobile app, e.g. 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SPAN
reauth_confirm.description: Your SPAN session expired. Sign in again to refresh access. Keep the existing device UUID — the telemetry channel is bound to it.

data_description.device_uuid: Leave as-is unless you are deliberately switching clients.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SPAN cloud. Please try again.
error.invalid_device_uuid: That is not a valid UUID.
error.no_telemetry: Signed in, but SPAN sent no telemetry on the channel for this device UUID. Check that it matches the UUID your SPAN mobile app uses.

abort.already_configured: This SPAN account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials are for a different SPAN account than the one being re-authenticated.
